title: Upgrade action is available to SUPERADMIN on the Plans tab after a deploy
preconditions: Org is on a self-serve tier below the top public plan
steps: Confirm an upgrade CTA is present and clickable for at least one higher self-serve tier
expectedResult: Upgrade CTA is visible and opens UpgradeModal; no regression hid the action after the last deploy.

title: Downgrade UI correctly blocks an enterprise-tier org and surfaces the CSM contact path
steps: Attempt to select a downgrade target
expectedResult: DowngradeModal shows its 'blocked' state referencing csm@vibrantix.ai, matching the backend's 409 DOWNGRADE_NOT_ALLOWED — the UI does not let the request silently no-op or show a generic error.

title: TierGate renders the correct required-tier name for a known gated feature
preconditions: Org on a tier below the one required for a known gated feature (e.g. vciso.advisor)
steps: Navigate to the gated feature's page
expectedResult: Alert text names the actual required tier for that feature (matches plan.features/moduleDefaults), not a stale or hardcoded tier name left over from a previous pricing revision.

title: 'Set up payment' CTA appears only when plan.status or a framework's status is pending_payment
preconditions: Org has an active, fully-paid subscription with no pending_payment states
expectedResult: 'Set up payment' CTA is absent, since neither plan.status nor any framework is pending_payment.

title: 'Renews In N Days' stat recalculates correctly immediately after a plan upgrade
preconditions: Org just completed a self-serve upgrade in the current session
steps: Check the 'Renews In N Days' stat card on Overview
expectedResult: N reflects the days between now and the (possibly updated) renewsAt returned by the upgrade response, not a stale value cached from before the upgrade.
